name: Senior Backend Go Engineer
description: Candidate with deep verbatim experience matching every core requirement of the role.
jobDescription:
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of production experience with Golang building high-throughput microservices
- Experience designing and optimizing PostgreSQL databases, schemas, and query execution plans
- Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka for event-driven architectures and streaming
- Production Kubernetes experience including deployments, ingress, and Helm charts
- Strong background in building gRPC and RESTful APIs with automated testing
resumeText:
Alex Rivera
Senior Backend Infrastructure Engineer
Email: alex.rivera@example.com | GitHub: github.com/arivera-go

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Staff-level backend engineer with 7 years of specialized experience in Go, distributed stream processing, and cloud-native orchestration.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Go (Golang), SQL, Python, Bash
Infrastructure & Storage: PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)
Protocols & Patterns: gRPC, Protocol Buffers, REST, Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, CI/CD

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Backend Engineer | CloudScale Systems | 2021 - Present
- Architected and maintained 14 mission-critical microservices written in Golang handling 45,000 requests per second with P99 latency under 20ms.
- Tuned PostgreSQL query execution plans, indexes, and partitioning, reducing average analytical query latency by 42% on a 3TB operational database.
- Built real-time event streaming pipeline using Apache Kafka processing 120M events daily with guaranteed at-least-once delivery semantics.
- Managed Kubernetes deployments on AWS EKS using Helm charts, automated horizontal pod autoscaling, and configured Istio service mesh ingress controllers.
- Designed gRPC and RESTful public and internal service APIs with 92% unit test coverage using Go testing and testify.

Software Engineer | DataCore Systems | 2017 - 2021
- Developed high-concurrency Go services for telemetry ingestion.
- Maintained relational PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, and connection pooling.
